icons.name: AI-BI
icons.description: Databricks AI/BI combines artificial intelligence with business intelligence to enable natural language queries and AI-powered insights on lakehouse data.

icons.name: Agent Bricks
icons.description: Agent Bricks is a Databricks framework for building and deploying AI agents that can reason, plan, and take actions using enterprise data and tools.
use_cases: Automated data workflows with AI agents

icons.name: Apps
icons.description: This icon represents the Databricks ecosystem of applications, integrations, and solutions available to enhance platform functionality. It signifies access to a marketplace or a collection of tools.
use_cases: Representing a section for discovering and managing third-party integrations or partner solutions.
Indicating a link to the Databricks Marketplace or an internal application store.
Symbolizing a collection of pre-built solutions, accelerators, or custom applications within the platform.

icons.name: Clean Rooms
icons.description: Databricks Clean Rooms provide a secure, privacy-preserving environment for multiple organizations to collaborate on data without sharing raw datasets. It enables joint analytics and insights while maintaining strict data governance and compliance.
use_cases: Securely combine customer data from multiple partners for joint marketing campaigns without exposing individual customer details.
Collaborate with healthcare providers on patient data analysis while adhering to strict privacy regulations like HIPAA or GDPR.
Perform joint fraud detection across financial institutions using anonymized transaction data.

icons.name: Dashboards
icons.description: Visualize and share insights from your data using interactive charts, tables, and text. Databricks Dashboards provide a powerful way to present analytical results and monitor key metrics.
use_cases: Presenting key business performance indicators to stakeholders.
Sharing interactive data analysis results and insights with teams.
Monitoring operational metrics and data trends over time.

icons.name: Databricks One
icons.description: Databricks One represents the unified data and AI platform, consolidating data warehousing, data engineering, machine learning, and streaming into a single, collaborative environment. It simplifies data management and accelerates AI innovation across the entire data lifecycle.
use_cases: Building and managing end-to-end data pipelines and lakehouses
Developing, training, and deploying machine learning models at scale
Performing real-time analytics and business intelligence on large datasets

icons.name: Databricks SQL
icons.description: Databricks SQL is a serverless data warehousing solution on the Lakehouse Platform, enabling analysts to run high-performance SQL queries on their data lake. It combines the best features of data warehouses with the flexibility of data lakes.
use_cases: Running high-performance SQL queries on large datasets in a data lake for analytics.
Powering business intelligence (BI) dashboards and reports with fresh, reliable data.
Enabling data analysts to access and analyze data directly using standard SQL tools and connectors.

icons.name: Databricks
icons.description: A unified data analytics platform built on Apache Spark, offering tools for data engineering, machine learning, and data warehousing through its Lakehouse architecture.
use_cases: Building and managing data lakes and data warehouses
Developing and deploying machine learning models
Performing large-scale data processing and analytics

icons.name: Delta Sharing
icons.description: Represents Delta Sharing, an open protocol developed by Databricks for securely sharing live data from a data lakehouse with other organizations, regardless of their computing platform.
use_cases: Sharing data securely with partners, customers, or vendors.
Enabling cross-organizational data collaboration and analytics.
Distributing data products and datasets without complex ETL.

icons.name: Genie
icons.description: Genie is an AI-powered assistant integrated within the Databricks Lakehouse Platform, designed to enhance user productivity. It provides intelligent guidance for data exploration, code generation, and query optimization, making data tasks more intuitive and efficient.
use_cases: Generating SQL queries or Python code snippets for common data analysis tasks.
Troubleshooting errors in notebooks or suggesting optimizations for Spark jobs.
Explaining complex data schemas and recommending relevant datasets for a given problem.

icons.name: Lakebase
icons.description: Lakebase is a foundational Databricks service designed to unify data storage, processing, and analytics on a robust data lake architecture. It provides a scalable and secure platform for all your data needs.

icons.name: Lakebridge
icons.description: Lakebridge simplifies migration of legacy data warehouses and ETL workloads to the Databricks Lakehouse platform.

icons.name: Lakeflow Connect
icons.description: Lakeflow Connect provides pre-built connectors for ingesting data from enterprise sources like databases, SaaS applications, and file systems into the lakehouse.

icons.name: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines
icons.description: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables) enables building reliable data pipelines using a declarative approach with automatic data quality management.

icons.name: Lakeflow Designer
icons.description: Lakeflow Designer provides a visual, low-code interface for designing and building data pipelines on the Databricks platform.

icons.name: Lakeflow Jobs
icons.description: Lakeflow Jobs orchestrates and schedules data processing workflows, managing dependencies and retries across the Databricks platform.

icons.name: Lakeflow
icons.description: Lakeflow is a Databricks service designed for building, orchestrating, and monitoring complex data pipelines and workflows directly on the Lakehouse Platform. It enables seamless integration of data ingestion, transformation, and machine learning tasks.
use_cases: Automating daily ETL jobs for data warehousing and analytics.
Orchestrating end-to-end machine learning model training and deployment pipelines.
Building real-time data ingestion and processing flows for operational dashboards.

icons.name: Lakehouse
icons.description: Represents the Databricks Lakehouse Platform, a unified architecture that combines the best features of data lakes and data warehouses. It provides a single source of truth for all data, enabling robust analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads.
use_cases: Building a modern data platform for all data types
Enabling real-time analytics and business intelligence
Developing and deploying machine learning and deep learning models

icons.name: Marketplace
icons.description: Databricks Marketplace is a platform for discovering, sharing, and monetizing data, AI models, and solutions directly within the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
use_cases: Discovering and acquiring third-party datasets or pre-trained AI models.
Monetizing proprietary data products, AI solutions, or industry-specific assets.
Facilitating secure data and AI asset exchange with partners or within an organization.

icons.name: Mosaic AI
icons.description: Represents Databricks Mosaic AI, a comprehensive platform for building, training, and deploying AI models, particularly large language models (LLMs) and generative AI applications.
use_cases: Developing and fine-tuning large language models (LLMs)
Building and deploying generative AI applications
Managing the end-to-end lifecycle of AI models at scale

icons.name: Notebooks
icons.description: Interactive web-based environments for developing and running code, visualizations, and narrative text. Essential for data science, machine learning, and data engineering workflows on Databricks.
use_cases: Developing and testing data transformation scripts
Building and training machine learning models
Performing exploratory data analysis and visualization

icons.name: Photon
icons.description: Databricks Photon is a vectorized query engine designed to accelerate data processing on Delta Lake and Apache Spark. It significantly boosts performance for large-scale data analytics and machine learning workloads.
use_cases: Improving performance of interactive analytics dashboards
